Thanks, Gillian — got the COI and the subcontractor list. Quick clarifications from procurement before we route this to Finance for PO creation:

1) Additional insured: we require Redwood Technologies, Inc. (DBA Redwood Inference) to be named as Additional Insured on the GL policy with primary & non-contributory language. Can your broker add this endorsement or provide an endorsement form?

2) Waiver of subrogation: we need it for Workers’ Comp and GL where permitted by law.

3) Cyber policy: can you confirm Retroactive Date (if any) and whether the policy includes third-party breach response coverage?

4) Effective dates: we’ll need confirmation that policies remain active through the initial 12-month term.

Marissa — looping you in for procurement acceptance and to confirm whether the provided limits meet our minimums. If the endorsement is not available, there are conditional PO paths (short-term hold) but we’d prefer a clean PO.

Gillian — if easier, I can draft the exact endorsement language for your broker. Also, please add a signed copy of the Master Services Agreement (we had the term sheet on the call) — either PDF or DocuSign link works.

Thanks,
